info.name: AbroadMates API
info.description: Run the folders top to bottom: "1. Lookups" stores option ids, "2. Auth" stores tokens, later folders reuse them. Seed accounts use password Password123 (student@example.com, mentor1..4@example.com are live mentors, mentor5@example.com is an empty draft for the wizard). In development emails are printed in the API console.

item.name: Study destinations by region + has mentors (step 4)

exec: const g = body.data.find((c) => c.slug === 'germany'); if (g) pm.collectionVariables.set('countryId', g.id);

item.name: Every country in the world (nationality, location, bank)

exec: pm.test('many countries', () => pm.expect(body.data.length).to.be.above(150)); const bd = body.data.find((c) => c.isoCode === 'BD'); if (bd) pm.collectionVariables.set('nationalityId', bd.id);

const s20 = body.data.find((s) => s.durationMin === 20); const s40 = body.data.find((s) => s.durationMin === 40); if (s20) pm.collectionVariables.set('service20Id', s20.id); if (s40) pm.collectionVariables.set('service40Id', s40.id);

item.name: Pricing markets (BDT / USD, 30% fee, recommended prices)

exec: const bd = body.data.find((m) => m.currency === 'BDT'); const intl = body.data.find((m) => m.currency === 'USD'); if (bd) pm.collectionVariables.set('marketBdId', bd.id); if (intl) pm.collectionVariables.set('marketIntlId', intl.id);
const d = body.data; const set = (k, v) => v && pm.collectionVariables.set(k, v.id);

set('bgProgramId', d.programs.find((p) => p.isBackgroundOnly)); set('platformId', d.socialPlatforms.find((p) => p.slug === 'linkedin')); set('payoutMethodId', d.payoutMethods.find((m) => m.slug === 'paypal'));

item.name: Free slots of a mentor for the 20 min call

pm.collectionVariables.set('slotFrom', new Date(Date.now() + 864e5).toISOString()); pm.collectionVariables.set('slotTo', new Date(Date.now() + 9 * 864e5).toISOString());

pm.test('has slots', () => pm.expect(body.data.length).to.be.above(2)); pm.collectionVariables.set('slotStart', body.data[body.data.length > 3 ? Math.floor(Math.random() * body.data.length) : 0].startsAt);
